eras.label: Baroque
eras.description: Counterpoint, dance, and the singing line.

eras.label: Romantic & late Romantic
eras.description: Intimacy and ambition, from sonata to symphony.

eras.label: 20th-century European
eras.description: New colours, new rhythms, and old forms reimagined.

eras.label: American, modern & contemporary
eras.description: A broad tradition, from concert hall to minimalism.

forms.label: Symphony
forms.description: An orchestral work in multiple movements.

works.title: Beethoven’s Missing Quartet
works.subtitle: String quartet in D minor
works.description: One four-note cell, four movements: a new AI-composed homage, not a rediscovered work by Beethoven.

movements.label: I. Poco sostenuto. Allegro agitato
movements.note: Slow introduction and sonata-form Allegro.

movements.label: II. Adagio molto espressivo
movements.note: A B-flat-major hymn with a darker middle.

movements.label: III. Scherzo. Allegro molto
movements.note: A terse D-minor scherzo and a rustic D-major trio.

movements.label: IV. Allegro con fuoco. Presto
movements.note: A rondo with a fugato and a D-major release.

works.title: Bach’s Missing Violin Sonata
works.subtitle: Sonata in E minor for violin and keyboard
works.description: Four movements, slow–fast–slow–fast, grown from one rising motto (B–E–F♯–G): a new AI-composed homage to Bach’s sonatas for violin and obbligato keyboard, not a rediscovered work by Bach.

movements.label: I. Adagio
movements.note: A two-bar subject passes from violin to right hand to bass; a chromatic lament bass before the return.

movements.label: II. Allegro
movements.note: A three-voice fugue in da capo form, with a stretto before the close.

movements.label: III. Andante un poco
movements.note: G major. A canon at the octave between violin and right hand over a detached bass.

movements.label: IV. Allegro
movements.note: A fugal gigue; the subject returns upside down after the double bar.

works.title: Bernstein’s Missing Quartet
works.subtitle: String quartet in A
works.description: One motto of two rising fourths, four movements: a 7/8 Allegro, a blues scherzo, a song in 5/4 and a dancing finale. A new AI-composed homage, not a work by Leonard Bernstein.

movements.label: I. Allegro con brio
movements.note: A 7/8 sonata movement on the motto: fanfare, plucked first theme, a sung second theme, and a fugato whose climax plays both themes at once.

movements.label: II. Scherzo: Riffs
movements.note: A twelve-bar blues in 12/8 swing over a walking bass, with solo choruses and a hushed fugato.

movements.label: III. Andante con tenerezza
movements.note: A song in 5/4 that opens with the motto’s two rising fourths; a restless middle; the cello sings the song a last time.

movements.label: IV. Finale: Allegro giocoso
movements.note: A rondo in 6/8 against 3/4; the slow movement’s song returns over the dance.

works.title: Dvořák’s Missing Symphony
works.subtitle: Symphony in B minor
works.description: A compact four-movement symphony for a twelve-staff orchestra: sonata Allegro, Adagio with a dumka, furiant, and a finale that recalls the earlier themes. A new AI-composed homage, not a rediscovered work by Dvořák.

movements.label: I. Allegro maestoso
movements.note: Sonata form in B minor: a brooding theme with a flat seventh, a pentatonic second theme in D, a recapitulation that turns to B major and back.

movements.label: II. Adagio
movements.note: A wind chorale frames a pentatonic song for oboe; the middle is a small dumka in G minor.

movements.label: III. Scherzo: Furiant
movements.note: A furiant in D major with its two-against-three strides, and a drone trio in G.

movements.label: IV. Finale: Allegro con fuoco
movements.note: A stamping B minor dance, a broad second theme, and a B major coda on the first movement’s theme.

works.title: Beethoven’s Missing Symphony
works.subtitle: Symphony in F minor
works.description: A compact symphony in F minor on one terse motto, which the finale turns to F major: Allegro, variations, scherzo with a horn trio, finale. A new AI-composed homage, not a rediscovered work by Beethoven.

movements.label: I. Allegro con brio
movements.note: Sonata form on a motto in octaves (a dotted rise to D flat, falling to C), with a fugato in the development.

movements.label: II. Andante con moto
movements.note: A hymn-like theme in D flat with two variations, a minor episode and a clarinet coda.

movements.label: III. Scherzo: Allegro vivace
movements.note: A clipped F minor scherzo with a trio for the two horns.

movements.label: IV. Finale: Allegro molto
movements.note: The motto in the major as main theme, a singing second theme, and a Presto coda.

works.title: Glass’s Missing Quartet
works.subtitle: String quartet in G minor
works.description: Four movements built from chord cycles, mirrored arpeggios and bars that grow and shrink by one beat. A new AI-composed homage, not a work by Philip Glass.

movements.label: Movement I
movements.note: An eight-chord cycle in G minor in mirrored arpeggios, with a slow violin line and a three-against-two middle.

movements.label: Movement II
movements.note: A rising scale gains a note at each return; the bars grow from three beats to six and shrink again.

movements.label: Movement III
movements.note: Interlocking arpeggios in C minor in bars of six, seven and eight eighths.

movements.label: Movement IV
movements.note: The first cycle returns under a climbing scale and thins to the viola alone.

works.title: Mozart’s Missing Symphony
works.subtitle: Symphony in C minor
works.description: A compact symphony in C minor, a key Mozart never used for a symphony: Allegro, Andante, Menuetto and Finale for flute, oboes, clarinets, bassoons, horns and strings. A new AI-composed homage, not a rediscovered work by Mozart.

movements.label: I. Allegro
movements.note: Sonata form in C minor with the exposition repeated; the second theme returns in the minor.

movements.label: II. Andante
movements.note: A song in A flat for violins and woodwind with a middle section in F minor.

movements.label: III. Menuetto: Allegretto
movements.note: A sturdy C minor minuet and a C major trio for the woodwind.

movements.label: IV. Finale: Allegro assai
movements.note: A scurrying C minor finale that stays in the minor to the end.

works.title: Shostakovich’s Missing Symphony
works.subtitle: Symphony in A minor
works.description: A bleak Moderato, a wrong-note polka, a Largo with an oboe lament, and a march that ends in a hammered A major. A new AI-composed homage, not a work by Dmitri Shostakovich.

movements.label: I. Moderato
movements.note: A bleak theme in the low strings, a lonely flute melody, and a march rhythm that builds to a climax and breaks off.

movements.label: II. Allegretto
movements.note: A shrill wrong-note polka with xylophone and a clownish bassoon trio.

movements.label: III. Largo
movements.note: A string chorale, an oboe lament, and a climax for the full orchestra that drains away.

movements.label: IV. Allegro non troppo
movements.note: A march on the first movement’s theme; the coda turns it to A major over one repeated note.

works.title: Debussy’s Missing Symphony
works.subtitle: Symphony in D flat
works.description: Four movements in shimmering strings, harp and solo winds: a floating first movement, a light 9/8 dance, a slow movement of parallel chords, and a finale that gathers the earlier themes. A new AI-composed homage, not a work by Claude Debussy.

movements.label: I. Très modéré
movements.note: Murmuring violas and harp, a call for cor anglais and horn, a floating flute theme, and a whole-tone middle.

movements.label: II. Assez vif et léger
movements.note: A light dance in 9/8 over harp and plucked basses, with a cor anglais melody in the middle.

movements.label: III. Lent et expressif
movements.note: Parallel seventh chords in the strings and a long flute arabesque.

movements.label: IV. Animé
movements.note: A broad pentatonic tune; the first movement’s theme, call and whole-tone music return; a bright ending.

works.title: Bach’s Missing Symphony
works.subtitle: Sinfonia in D major
works.description: An imagined four-movement sinfonia in Bach’s orchestral-suite manner, a form he never wrote: French overture with fugue, Siciliano for oboe, a pair of minuets and a fugal gigue, for trumpets, timpani, oboes, bassoon, strings and harpsichord. A new AI-composed homage, not a rediscovered work by Bach.

movements.label: I. Ouverture: Grave – Vivace – Grave
movements.note: A dotted Grave, a four-voice fugue with episodes for oboes and for strings, and a short return of the Grave.

movements.label: II. Siciliano: Andante
movements.note: B minor: a lilting song for solo oboe over strings and harpsichord, in two repeated halves.

movements.label: III. Menuet I – Menuet II – Menuet I
movements.note: A D major minuet for the full band around a D minor minuet for two oboes and bassoon.

movements.label: IV. Gigue: Allegro
movements.note: A fugal gigue in two repeated halves; the second begins with the subject upside down.

works.title: Handel’s Missing Symphony
works.subtitle: Sinfonia in F major
works.description: An imagined four-movement sinfonia in the manner of Handel’s concerti grossi and outdoor music, a form he never wrote: a ritornello Allegro, a D minor Larghetto, a hornpipe and a chaconne, for horns, oboes, bassoon, strings and harpsichord. A new AI-composed homage, not a rediscovered work by Handel.

movements.label: I. Largo – Allegro
movements.note: A stately introduction and a ritornello Allegro with episodes for oboes, strings and horns.

movements.label: II. Larghetto
movements.note: D minor: a sarabande-like air for strings, then for solo oboe.

movements.label: III. Alla Hornpipe
movements.note: A syncopated hornpipe in 3/2 around a quiet D minor middle section for strings.

movements.label: IV. Chaconne
movements.note: Seventeen variations on a four-bar ground bass, four of them in F minor.

works.title: Vivaldi’s Missing Symphony
works.subtitle: Sinfonia in G minor
works.description: A three-movement sinfonia for strings and continuo in the manner of the dozens Vivaldi wrote, with a solo violin borrowed from his concertos: a unison-ritornello Allegro, a Largo over plucked strings and a driving Presto. A new AI-composed homage, not a rediscovered work by Vivaldi.

movements.label: I. Allegro
movements.note: A hammering unison ritornello and falling sequences, with four episodes for the solo violin.

movements.label: II. Largo
movements.note: E flat major: the solo violin sings over plucked strings, its first strain repeated with decoration.

movements.label: III. Presto
movements.note: A driving 3/8 dance in two repeated halves on one eight-bar theme.

works.title: Haydn’s Missing Symphony
works.subtitle: Symphony in B flat major
works.description: A four-movement symphony in the manner of Haydn’s London symphonies: a slow introduction and a nearly monothematic Allegro with a false reprise, an Adagio cantabile, a Menuet with an oboe Trio, and a rondo Finale full of pauses. For flute, oboes, bassoons, horns, trumpets, timpani and strings. A new AI-composed homage, not a rediscovered work by Haydn.

movements.label: I. Adagio – Allegro
movements.note: A slow introduction that darkens to the minor, and a sonata-form Allegro built almost entirely from one theme.

movements.label: II. Adagio cantabile
movements.note: F major: a song for violins and flute around a troubled F minor middle section.

movements.label: III. Menuet: Allegretto – Trio
movements.note: A menuet that stops for a bar of silence, and a country-dance Trio for solo oboe.

movements.label: IV. Finale: Presto
movements.note: A rondo on a contredanse tune with a stormy G minor episode and teasing pauses.

works.title: C. P. E. Bach’s Missing Symphony
works.subtitle: Symphony in A minor
works.description: Three linked movements in the abrupt, expressive manner of C. P. E. Bach’s Hamburg symphonies: unison outbursts, sudden silences and hushed answers in the Allegro di molto, a Larghetto for two flutes, and a headlong Presto. For flutes, oboes, bassoon, horns, strings and harpsichord. A new AI-composed homage, not a rediscovered work by C. P. E. Bach.

movements.label: I. Allegro di molto
movements.note: Jagged unisons, hushed answers and tremolo outbursts; the end dissolves towards the slow movement.

movements.label: II. Larghetto
movements.note: F major: two flutes in thirds over hushed strings, with a restless middle in flat keys.

movements.label: III. Presto
movements.note: A headlong 6/8 finale in two repeated halves, ending in scales for everyone in octaves.

works.title: Schubert’s Missing Symphony
works.subtitle: Symphony in A major
works.description: A lyrical four-movement symphony in A major, a key Schubert never used for one: a clarinet song and a cello theme that arrives a third away from where it is expected, a walking Andante, a Scherzo with a ländler Trio, and a Finale in constant motion. For double woodwind, horns, trumpets, timpani and strings. A new AI-composed homage, not a rediscovered or completed work by Schubert.

movements.label: I. Allegro moderato
movements.note: A clarinet song over murmuring strings; the cellos’ second theme arrives in a distant C major.

movements.label: II. Andante con moto
movements.note: F major: a walking song shadowed by the minor, with a stormy D minor episode.

movements.label: III. Scherzo: Allegro vivace – Trio
movements.note: A quick scherzo that drops suddenly into C major, and a ländler Trio for clarinet.

movements.label: IV. Finale: Allegro vivace
movements.note: A sonata-rondo in constant motion with a singing second theme for the woodwind.

works.title: Schumann’s Missing Symphony
works.subtitle: Symphony in F minor
works.description: Four movements bound together by a four-note motto (F, A flat, G, C): an impetuous F minor first movement, a Romanze around a trombone chorale, a Scherzo of cross-rhythms, and a Finale that turns the motto and the first theme to F major. For double woodwind, four horns, trumpets, trombones, timpani and strings. A new AI-composed homage, not a rediscovered work by Schumann.

movements.label: I. Ziemlich langsam – Lebhaft
movements.note: The motto in horns and trombones, then an impetuous F minor movement built from it.

movements.label: II. Romanze: Andante
movements.note: D flat major: a song for clarinet and bassoon around a quiet brass chorale on the motto.

movements.label: III. Scherzo: Lebhaft – Trio
movements.note: F minor broken chords and hammered cross-rhythms; a calm Trio in D flat.

movements.label: IV. Langsam – Lebhaft
movements.note: F major: the motto and first theme turned to the major, with a chorale and a faster coda.
